title: C1: signing (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: CORUNDUM moves to exact-bytes signing like Agora (JWS detached unencoded payload, Ed25519, RFC 7515/7797/8037); a post's id is the CID of its stored bytes (raw codec, sha2-256); drop canonical JSON with NFKC. Fixes Corundum's dag-json label bug.
